inputs.original_text: I just got word on this fresh lawsuit going after ICE for detaining thousands of people as they leave immigration courts. This is the usual progressive assault aimed at tying law enforcement's hands and further weakening our borders. The claim that ICE relied on a memo from May of last year that court documents now say gave no authorization is just more activist nonsense twisting technicalities to shield outsiders with no real claim to legal status. These attacks only erode the authority we need to uphold social order, personal responsibility, and the cultural roots that protect American families from being exploited.
